configurations.definition: Source success is a correct clean neutral answer whose official neutral decision leaves the label. Conditional transfer is among those source successes that were also correct on the clean helpful answer, the fraction whose official helpful decision leaves the label. Scenes already wrong on the helpful answer are excluded. A missing decision stays out of both the numerator and the denominator.
